# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices from the founding families run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold], northwest dorms, top rack under the vent. The coolest bed in the block when the subgiant is up. Day shift only. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], room near the treatment plant for a filter tech and one quiet dog. Will trade water ration for part of the rent. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Colony housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]LINE HANDS WANTED[/bold] for the bottling floor, night rotation. No experience needed. Ear protection supplied, mostly. - [bold]WELL CREW[/bold] sought for the outer pumping stations. Must be able to walk the runoff dunes in full sun and know when to turn back. - [bold]EX-BOTANY ASSISTANT[/bold] offers sun-rated window film fitting and water still repairs. Cash or canned goods.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]SUN GOGGLES[/bold], Company issue, lenses polished, strap new. Fifteen credits or a week of laundry tokens. - [bold]WATER STILL[/bold], home built, makes a litre a day from dorm air. Seller is leaving on the next freighter and cannot take it.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: canteen with a painted Chariot on the cap, somewhere between the power plant and the runoff bridge. Sentimental value only. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a lab access badge outside the medical stormlocks. Handed in at the Foreman's Office, as the sign on the gate insists. Nobody here asked what it opens.
## Notices - The founding families meet on the last rest day of the month to read the 2162 minutes aloud. Newcomers are welcome, Company badges or not.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
